subtopics.title: Plan Symbols, Scale and Actual Dimensions

questions.question: On a floor plan, thin double lines interrupting a wall show:
options: A window set into that wall

questions.question: At 1 : 100, a lounge wall measuring 50 mm on the plan is really:
A real bookshelf 1,8 m wide appears on a 1 : 100 plan as:
The plan-reading sanity check on room sizes says:
options: Kitchens are always the smallest rooms
Rooms come out between about 2 and 8 metres — a 50 m or half-metre lounge announces a conversion slip

questions.question: The EAST elevation of a building shows:
options: The outside face of the wall that faces east, seen horizontally — including heights the floor plan cannot show
The view looking down from the east
The eastern half of the floor plan
The fence on the east boundary

questions.question: To identify which elevation is which, the detective method is:
options: Choose the drawing with the tallest roof
Use the north arrow, list the openings the floor plan puts on each face, and match counts and positions to each elevation
Measure the thickness of the walls
Pick the drawing with the most detail

questions.question: The floor plan gives a window's width as 1 500 mm; the elevation gives its height as 1 200 mm. The glass area is:
When drawing a 1 : 100 plan of a 3 m by 2,5 m laundry, the marks sit in:
options: A perspective sketch of the room
Correct ratios — a 30 mm by 25 mm outline — standard symbols, labelled dimensions and a stated scale

questions.question: An exploded view shows the parts:
options: Floated apart along the lines where they join, so the eye sees what touches what and in which order

questions.question: The inventory check — counting parts against the list BEFORE starting — matters because:
options: Discovering a missing screw at step eight costs an undoing of steps seven back to one
Parts rust if left in the box

questions.question: Fourteen screws are needed and screws come in packets of four. You must buy:
options: Four packets — packets are sold whole, so answers round UP, leaving two spare

questions.question: A full-marks answer to 'what goes wrong if step 4 is done before step 3' must:
options: Name the specific failure — the blocked groove or the screw hole that can no longer be reached

questions.question: Rooibos boxes 8 × 5 × 12 cm packed upright into a 40 × 25 × 24 cm crate give:
options: 50 — five by five per layer, two layers, agreeing with the volume check 24 000 ÷ 480

questions.question: Volume division alone can overpromise a packing answer because:
options: Volume formulas only work for cubes
It ignores that only WHOLE items fit along each axis — a leftover 4 cm slice holds nothing
Crates are always full of padding

questions.question: A shop counter 3 m by 1,2 m modelled at 1 : 20 measures:
options: 15 cm by 6 cm — and its top AREA is 1/400 of the real counter, the scale factor squared

questions.question: The 20 m² floor needs 500 tiles of 0,04 m² each. With 10% extra, sold in boxes of 20, you buy:
options: 28 boxes — 550 tiles ÷ 20 = 27,5, rounded UP because shops do not split boxes

questions.question: At 1 : 100, the friendly conversion is:
options: Every centimetre of plan is a metre of building
Every metre of plan is a centimetre of building

questions.question: The quarter-moon at the lounge door matters for furniture because:
options: It shows where the sun comes in
It shows the door's swing — nothing bulky may stand in the arc where the door opens

questions.question: Parking the 1,8 m bookshelf on the plan as an 18 mm rectangle demonstrates that a plan lets you:
options: Rearrange furniture with a pencil before anything heavy is carried — at no cost to anyone's back

questions.question: The floor plan is silent about:
options: UP — heights of ceilings, windows and roofs live in the elevations and sections

questions.question: The mirror trap in matching elevations is that:
options: Facing a wall from outside flips left and right — like an oncoming taxi whose driver sits on the vehicle's right yet appears on your left
North arrows point south on elevations

questions.question: A nearly blank elevation with one tiny window most likely faces:
options: The side where the plan puts the bathroom

questions.question: When a question says DRAW, it awards marks for:
options: Right ratios, standard symbols, labelled sizes and a stated scale — neat and correct counts, art does not

subtopics.title: Crates, Shelves and the Hardware List

questions.question: The dotted line in the exploded bookshelf diagram shows:
options: The screw's flight path home — through washer, through shelf, into side panel, in that exact order
A part left out of the kit

questions.question: The paint chain for the lounge is:
options: 46,8 m² times two coats = 93,6 m², so 11 litres
Area 46,8, minus door 1,8 and window 1,8 = 43,2; times two coats = 86,4; at 9 m² per litre = 9,6, so buy 10 litres
43,2 m² divided by two coats = 3 litres

questions.question: Why add 10 percent to the tile count before buying?
options: Cutting at edges and breakage consume extra tiles — 500 becomes 550, then 28 whole boxes

questions.question: If the rooibos boxes were a centimetre longer, the honest packing answer would come from:
options: Counting WHOLE boxes axis by axis — whole rows vanish while the volume sum barely blinks, and the leftover slice ships only air
